[ASSISTANT_SAID] To improve car handling, consider upgrading to stiffer springs, adjustable coilovers, sway bars, bushings and mounts, camber and toe adjustments, and lightweight wheels and tires.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General tips to improve lap times include checking tire pressure and temperature, upgrading brake pads and fluid, ensuring proper seat and safety equipment, focusing on driver training and feedback, and familiarizing with the track layout.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Upgrading brake fluid is recommended when installing new brake pads, especially for track use, due to compatibility, moisture absorption, high-temperature performance, and corrosion protection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested high-performance brake fluid brands include Castrol SRF, Motul RBF 660, AP Racing PRF 660, and Brembo HTX.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To maximize engine performance, consider checking the air filter and intake, using high-octane fuel, verifying spark plug gapping and indexing, checking the ignition system, optimizing fuel injection and tuning, ensuring proper engine oil and cooling, inspecting intake and exhaust systems, performing engine compression and leak-down tests, checking the drivetrain and transmission, and practicing smooth driving techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For the dyno test, ensure the car is in good condition, choose the right dyno, prepare the car properly, get multiple runs, and interpret the results correctly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A dyno test can help identify areas for improvement and provide a baseline for future modifications.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should ensure their car is in good condition before the dyno test, including having the correct tire pressure, a full tank of gas, and the correct fluids.
